### Enduring Hurled Stones
Author: Fred Alberti
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-june-23-2009-11605077.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:12
Points:
- God frequently calls ordinary believers to accomplish extraordinary work for His kingdom.
- Stephen demonstrated courageous faith by preaching God's truth even as hostility mounted against him.
- Following Christ often requires standing firm despite facing personal danger and suffering.
- Believers can endure hardships knowing that the exalted Christ watches over and sustains them.

### Our Calling: What We Fight For
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/church-leaders/our-calling-what-we-fight-for?ga=testimonial-resources
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:12-13
Points:
- Christian ministry is a spiritual battleground where leaders are called to defend orthodox truth.
- Defending the faith must never turn into argumentative behavior or personal bullying.
- Ministry requires combining tough convictions and discernment with genuine tenderness toward people.
- The adversary in the conflict is the devil rather than other people.
- Believers overcome spiritual hostility not by human strength, but through Christ's victory.
